title: How do you calculate option SL and TP premiums from underlying chart levels before entering a trade?
text: I'm trading BTC options on Delta Exchange, and I'm trying to find an easy way to calculate the option's SL and TP premium before entering a trade. My strategy is based on price action. I first analyze the BTC chart, identify my entry, stop-loss and take-profit levels, and then choose an option to trade. For example: Option: 60200 CE (Buy) BTC market price: $59,000 Option entry premium: $460 Delta: 0.40 My underlying SL: $57,356 My underlying TP: $61,000 My problem is that I need to convert my underlying BTC SL and TP levels into option premium prices. I tried using the delta formula: Option price change = Delta × BTC price change But it gives me a negative SL premium because the BTC price movement is large. I understand that delta changes as the underlying price moves, so this method isn't accurate for larger movements. I also came across Black-Scholes, but it seems complicated for calculating this before every trade. My questions: Is there an easy way to calculate the estimated option premium at my underlying SL and TP levels? Is there any calculator or tool that can do this without manually calculating Black-Scholes? Can I calculate the option's SL and TP premiums using its IV, expiry, strike and current premium? How do experienced options traders calculate their RPT and position size before entering a trade? I want to know my potential loss and calculate the correct quantity/lots BEFORE placing an order. Any practical method, calculator or tool recommendation would be appreciated.
triage_reason: Trader needs a practical tool to calculate option SL and TP premiums beforehand.

title: Réforme de la facturation électronique en France
text: Bonjour à tous, Est-ce que quelqu’un a des informations concernant la réforme de la facturation électronique sur Shopify ? À partir de septembre 2027, les entreprises seront tenues d’envoyer leurs factures clients B2B via des plateformes agréées. Afin d’automatiser ce processus, il est nécessaire de récupérer le numéro de SIRET de la société. Or, à ce jour, il est impossible d’ajouter un numéro de SIRET dans le checkout Shopify. Savez-vous si Shopify prévoit une mise à jour de cette fonctionnalité pour répondre aux exigences de la réglementation française ? Merci pour vos retours. Paul 1 post - 1 participant Read full topic
author: Paul0017
triage_reason: Merchant needs to collect SIRET numbers at checkout for French electronic invoicing.
